versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the test-design skill for comprehensive testing guidance.
- Provides strategies for test design, planning, and coverage improvement.
- Includes guidance on the testing pyramid, test categories, and test case patterns (AAA, GWT).
- Details approaches for test doubles (mocks, stubs), data management, and test execution.
- Offers naming conventions, coverage targets, and best practices for effective and maintainable tests.
